Harvey introductory vortex, added 2026-11-06, cloth interaction added 2026-11-09

Implementation: dist/vortex.js, original project code.
No original Balatro game shader, third-party shader source, or library is bundled.

Visual/technical references consulted:
- Azkun/balatroShader author README:
  https://github.com/Azkun/balatroShader
  Describes centered trigonometric rotation, iterative transformations, palette,
  speed and spin controls in a public browser reconstruction.
- React Bits Balatro component overview:
  https://reactbits.dev/backgrounds/balatro
  Demonstrates the swirling paint and crisp pixel treatment.

This project uses independently written polar coordinates, three bounded
sinusoidal domain-warp passes, green/yellow palette bands and subtle pixel grain.
The gesture controller integrates a shared angle. A catch nudges the sheet,
then the first 0.32 radians of signed relative hand travel build cloth strain.
Beyond that slack the sheet turns, taking up strain as it catches the hand.
A contact-local field gathers the paint, stretches it along the pull and lights
the resulting ridges. The same fold field moves the foreground fragments.
Release eases the folds flat and coasts the sheet back to a slow idle turn.
Movement energy modulates the filaments and palette. The angle is integrated
and reduced motion holds the texture still.
Canvas2D fallback blends two precomputed paint textures and shares the global
angle. It remaps a feathered 96-by-96 patch of the backdrop at the contact.
Rendering is capped at DPR 1.5 and 1.5M pixels.

Balatro and its branding belong to their respective owners; this is an original
green/yellow website treatment inspired by its background, not official assets.
